summary.notes: SDK v0.1.0 foundation complete. AC-1 through AC-5 and AC-8 PASS. AC-6 and AC-7 partially deferred to v0.2.0 per strategic decision to separate SDK foundation release from product integration. SDK is fully functional as standalone library for new consumers (AIPhone). Product cutover requires full adapter implementation (T6.1-T6.5) which belongs in product repository.

strategic_decisions.decision: Defer T6 full adapter implementation to v0.2.0
strategic_decisions.rationale: SDK v0.1.0 delivers standalone foundation (contracts, runtime, profiles, conformance testing). Full product integration is product repository work, not SDK work. Deferring unblocks v0.1.0 release for other consumers (AIPhone) while allowing incremental product adoption.
strategic_decisions.impact: AC-6 and AC-7 marked DEFERRED. SDK v0.1.0 scope explicitly excludes production deployment in Simple Harness desktop app.
